# Vendored third-party data

## wmn-data.json

The WhatsMyName dataset, by Micah Hoffman and contributors.

- Source: https://github.com/WebBreacher/WhatsMyName
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)
- See WMN-LICENCE.txt for the full notice.

Vendored byte-for-byte unmodified. Share-alike attaches to modifications of the dataset, so
casefile never edits this file; any casefile-specific behaviour keys off site names instead.
